name: Scroll Area
description: Themed scroll container with edge fade shadows, stick-to-bottom feed mode with a New activity pill, end-reached callback for infinite loading and an imperative scroll handle.

props.name: stickToBottom
props.description: Keep pinned to newest content unless user scrolled up

props.name: contentKey
props.description: Change to signal new content for stickToBottom

props.name: onReachEnd
props.description: Called once when nearing the end

props.name: endThreshold
props.description: px from end that counts as reached
